newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady on narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady on narrow trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady in a narrow trading range on Wednesday on low consumer buying and low retail demand, dealers said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,280/1,320 rupees while M-30 was quiet at 1,300/1,365 rupees. Sugar mill delivery was steady at 1,220/1,230 rupees.
"Sentiment was firm at the close on lower free sale quota as well as expectation of higher physical demand ahead of Hindu festivals," one broker said.
The free sale quota for January is 650,000 tonnes down from 800,000 tonnes in December, he said.
